title: 36: Sanjuu Roku
synopsis: Anzu, a high school girl, lives in a household where her mother has created a "perfectly controlled environment." Defying her mother’s wishes isn’t even an option. She has no smartphone, no allowance, and her only small escape is sneaking off to the listening booths at a CD shop, hidden from her mother’s watchful gaze. One fateful night, at the station’s roundabout, she encounters someone unforgettable— A “dangerous guy” with a devilish face but an angel’s touch on the guitar. Feel the chills as you dive into this deeply moving story by a 22-year-old rising star.

These are the ultra-powerful and ultra-wealthy 13 dragons, mostly linked to the Mafia. About this competition which is of prime importance, they control the judges, and put pressure on some competitors worrisome. synopsis: Oriana, a seventeen-year-old magic student, suddenly dies alongside her boyfriend, Vincent. However, she returns from death in the body of her seven-year-old self with the memories of her past life intact–except for the knowledge of what killed her. She fantasizes for years about reuniting with her beloved, but when they finally meet, Vincent doesn't remember her! Can she make Vincent fall in love with her again and avoid the death that started this mysterious time loop? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Got 6th place in the 18th Manga Taisho Awards (2025).
